title: Servicemember Quality of Life Improvement and National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2025
sponsor_context: Formal sponsor of H.R. 5009, the originating legislative vehicle; the NDAA text was substituted later in the process.
last_action: Enacted as the Servicemember Quality of Life Improvement and National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2025.
summary: The FY2025 NDAA strengthened protection of advanced AI from adversary access, launched defense AI-and-biotechnology work, improved human-factors and evaluation infrastructure for military AI, and established the NSA Artificial Intelligence Security Center.

substance_sections.title: Advanced-AI national-security duties
substance_sections.summary: Directs the CDAO Governing Council to identify AI models that could create national-security risks, develop strategies to prevent adversary access, and recommend legislative or administrative action.

substance_sections.title: AI and biotechnology pilot program
substance_sections.summary: Creates a pilot program to develop and demonstrate near-term AI and machine-learning applications for biotechnology and national-security missions.

substance_sections.title: AI Human Factors Integration Initiative
substance_sections.summary: Establishes an initiative to study and improve how people interact with military AI, including operator trust, workload, decision-making, testing, and design guidance.

substance_sections.title: Advanced computing infrastructure for AI
substance_sections.summary: Directs the Defense Department to plan computing infrastructure that supports the development, testing, evaluation, and deployment of advanced AI capabilities.

substance_sections.title: Budgeting for AI data
substance_sections.summary: Requires Defense Department AI programs to estimate and budget for the data needed to train, maintain, and improve models, including data preparation, labeling, protection, and sustainment costs.

substance_sections.title: AI-enabled weapon-systems center of excellence
substance_sections.summary: Requires an evaluation of a center of excellence to share lessons, safety guidance, standards, benchmarks, training, and partner experience for AI-enabled weapon systems.

substance_sections.title: NSA Artificial Intelligence Security Center
substance_sections.summary: Establishes an AI Security Center within NSA's Cybersecurity Collaboration Center to develop counter-AI guidance and promote secure AI adoption for national-security systems and the defense industrial base.

committee_dynamics: These provisions were enacted through the annual defense and intelligence authorization vehicle rather than as standalone AI statutes. H.R. 5009 originally addressed wildlife-trafficking sanctions; the FY2025 NDAA text was later substituted into that vehicle, so David Joyce is the formal originating-bill sponsor rather than the NDAA's principal author.
advance_rationale: Enacted law; implementation replaces advancement forecasting.

responsible_agencies: Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer Governing Council

deadlines.requirement: Establish the Artificial Intelligence Security Center within the NSA Cybersecurity Collaboration Center within 90 days of enactment.

agency_status.detail: The enacted duties and organizational requirements are verified; a comprehensive official implementation assessment has not yet been completed for this grouped record.
NSA established its AI Security Center in the Cybersecurity Collaboration Center in September 2023 and continued to publish AI security guidance in May 2026.

verification_level: Official Congress.gov record, public-law text, and section grouping verified.
